title: ProjectE DRC/ERC gate report
description: Output of scripts/drc_gate.py, the hash-bindable harness that replaced tools/krt/drc.sh. Carries the EXACT kicad-cli argv, the engine identity, and an object census so an empty design cannot read as a clean one.

argv.description: MUST contain --exit-code-violations and --severity-all: without them kicad-cli exits 0 on a dirty design and the gate is decorative.

provenance.description: The two external variables that move a DRC count without the design moving: the engine version and the invocation flags. Lifted out of engine/argv so a consumer does not have to know where each lives. drc_gate.py --compare REFUSES to subtract two reports whose provenance differs or is unknown - a committed baseline of 191 violations was produced by kicad-cli 10.0.5 and read as a design regression against a 10.0.4 run of the same unchanged board.

engine_version.description: MEASURED with `kicad-cli version` at run time, never a constant in the source. An empty string, or the literal 'unknown', means the version could not be measured and any comparison against this artefact is refused.

engine_version_source.description: How the version was obtained, so a version copied out of the engine's own JSON is not mistaken for one measured from the binary.

engine_reported_version.description: kicad_version as the engine wrote it into its own report. Recorded beside the measured one so the two can be seen to agree.

argv_signature.description: argv with the executable, -o OUTPUT and every path-shaped token removed: the part that decides WHAT is counted. --all-track-errors alone moved this repo's board from ~184 to 292 violations, so two runs with different signatures are answering different questions. null means the invocation is unknown (a raw kicad-cli JSON records no command line at all).

parity_difference_count.description: null when --schematic-parity was not requested. NOT zero: kicad-cli returns an empty parity list either way, so a 0 would be indistinguishable from a measured clean parity, and anything comparing it against a threshold would report the empty agreement.

census.description: Objects read from the design file and handed to the engine. The coverage denominator.

exclusions.description: Checks the caller deliberately placed out of scope, each with the reason. Written by --exclude CHECK=REASON. An entry here removes a NO_COVERAGE check from the status rollup and NOTHING ELSE: a measured FAIL still fails the gate, and an exclusion with no reason is refused at the CLI. Absent or empty means the verdict covers every check.

$comment: scanned == 0 MUST be NO_COVERAGE. A rule this schema cannot express and drc_gate.py enforces: schematic_parity is reported NO_COVERAGE unless --schematic-parity was passed, because kicad-cli returns an EMPTY parity list without it. status is the MONOTONE rollup over checks[]: FAIL if any check FAILed, else NO_COVERAGE if any non-excluded check was not measured, else PASS. It used to be 'PASS unless something FAILed', so a run without --schematic-parity reported PASS while carrying an explicit schematic_parity NO_COVERAGE.
